entries.title: Integrations: one place for what your first mate and crew reach outside your projects
entries.body: Settings has a new Integrations tab. GitHub is the first integration, and your GitHub sign-in now lives there; Projects points to it. Your first mate and your crew on this computer can read through GitHub for you, and a change there waits for your click on a card. Open a row to turn an action off, or use its menu to check, pause or remove it. You can also open it from command search with Open Integrations.

picture.alt: Settings → Integrations with the GitHub row open, its read allowed and its change asking you
